hints.en: `HEALTHCHECK --interval=5s --timeout=3s --retries=3 CMD ["python", "healthcheck.py"]`; if you forget to copy it, the state becomes `unhealthy`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**Dockerfile**

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    DB_PATH=/data/notes.db \
    PORT=8000

RUN useradd --create-home --uid 1000 app \
 && mkdir /data \
 && chown app:app /data

WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app.py healthcheck.py ./

USER app
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=5s --timeout=3s --retries=3 CMD ["python", "healthcheck.py"]
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

**Dockerfile**

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
